encounter: C19 E0091 Mauville Gym (Angelo, Wind Power room); cap 30 Electric-gym counterteam
availability_audit: Mauville Gym counterteam built for the Electric rooms. NIDOKING (Nidoran-M wild Route101 gate 14 -> Nidorino -> Moon Stone, gate 20) and NIDOQUEEN (Nidoran-F wild Route101 gate 14 -> Nidorina -> Moon Stone, gate 20) are the two Ground bodies the crack lines name. GARDEVOIR (Ralts wild Route102 gate 14 -> Kirlia L20 -> Gardevoir L30) with ITEM_GARDEVOIRITE (stone-window 14; Mega Ring earned from Steven after Brawly). MAGEARNA (legendary_sign RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F, gate 14; declared reachable legend). KARTANA (wild PetalburgWoods_3, gate 20). WEAVILE (Sneasel wild Seaspray_Cave_B1F gate 14, condition evolution). Every source map is at or before Route 110, so a player standing in Mauville Gym can hold all six. Deliberately excluded although they are in pool-30 and would be strong here: every NewMauville source (Zapdos, Regieleki, Zekrom, Zeraora, Magnezone, Iron Hands, Eelektross, Meltan/Melmetal) because the Game Book gates New Mauville behind Surf in C28, far after this badge; every Route 111 desert species (Trapinch/Gible/Hippopotas/Sandaconda/Silicobra/Cacnea/Stonjourner) because the Go-Goggles arrive in C23; and Route 118 Manectric, which would be a silly answer to an Electric gym anyway. One reachable legend (Magearna) and one Mega (Gardevoir) are used and declared.
plan: Three of Angelo's six are Ground-immune (both Wind Power birds are Electric/Flying and Rotom Levitates), so Earth Power is only half a plan here and Ice Beam is the real weapon - 2x on both birds. Lead Assault Vest Nidoqueen + Assault Vest Magearna, the two bodies that survive a charged Choice Specs Thunderbolt and a Punk Rock Overdrive. Weavile is held for Knock Off on the Choice Specs and the Focus Sash, and I deliberately will not Fake Out the Tailwind caster on turn one so the authored Wind Power charge can be observed.
